parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the target CHEMBL4822. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to filter by target CHEMBL4822 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
